surface_mechanism_description: O radicals create reactive sites for precursor adsorption and effectively remove the diketonate ligands, leading to the formation of pure Y2O3 and Er2O3.
evidence: O radicals were found to create reactive sites for precursor adsorption and effectively remove the /H9252-diketonate ligands, leading to the formation of pure Y2O3 and Er2O3 at 300 and 330 °C, respectively.
